about.title: About FARMWITFIRMAN
about.subtitle: An agribusiness company committed to advancing Indonesian agriculture through innovation and technology.
about.storyP1: FARMWITFIRMAN was founded with one simple mission: making modern agriculture accessible to everyone. Starting from a small plot of land, we have grown into a digital agribusiness platform serving thousands of farmers and agricultural entrepreneurs across Indonesia.
about.storyP2: By combining over 15 years of field experience with cutting-edge technology, we provide comprehensive solutions from quality agricultural products, expert consulting, to intensive training programs.
about.visionText: To become the leading digital agribusiness platform in Southeast Asia, empowering farmers with modern technology and knowledge.
about.mission1: Provide high-quality and affordable agricultural products
about.mission2: Deliver professional consulting and training to increase crop yields
about.mission3: Develop environmentally friendly and sustainable farming technology
about.mission4: Build strategic partnerships for Indonesian farmers
